prerequisite: UL17 Stage B exact-current-byte causal adoption PASS and Stage C fresh exact-R69 architecture output sealed.
evidence_boundary: Architecture only: Episode Plan + Sequence Plan + Scene Plan. No screenplay prose.
instructions: Reward distinct story strands only when they have distinct causal roots, owners/desires and consequences.
Do not reward raw strand/scene counts.
Penalize a single initiating incident merely being decomposed into many logistical subproblems.
Reward justified intersections; do not require every strand to intersect.
Penalize redundant phase inflation, generic repeated transaction stages and scenes whose protected function is losslessly mergeable.
Evaluate whether supporting characters possess independent dramatic agency rather than serving as functional instruments for the protagonist.

comparison_design.control: Historical physical SYNC-R58 architecture-qualified candidate is not used as current Control. The current experiment must compare exact R69 against a frozen appropriate control chosen before outputs, with identical input state.
comparison_design.mapping: balanced hidden mapping sealed before judgments
comparison_design.reveal: only after 3/3 first schema-valid judgments are hash-sealed

gate.additional_noninferiority: No median axis loss worse than -0.50 on Ensemble/Relationship Weaving, Information Asymmetry, Social Ecology, Causal Continuity, Due/Deferred Handling.
gate.single_spine_rule: If >=2/3 judges classify the Treatment episode as a single causal spine with dependent subproblems rather than genuinely multi-strand architecture, Stage D FAIL regardless of aggregate wins.

diagnostics_not_quotas.note: These human-corpus observations are context diagnostics only. Architecture is not scored by matching these numbers mechanically.

no_posthoc_rule: Do not change axes, critical labels, thresholds, mapping policy or single-spine rule after first Stage C architecture output.
